howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Python 代码创建 AI 智能体。你可以定义函数让智能体自动执行，或生成独立智能体处理任务，支持记忆、工具调用和多智能体协作。
howto.when: 当你编写 Python 代码，需要构建 AI 智能体、集成 MCP 工具或实现多智能体协调时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 @agentic 装饰器写一个加法函数。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个智能体函数，自动计算两数之和。

say.text: 用 spawn 创建一个智能体，判断“地球是平的”这句话的真假。
say.note: Claude 会生成代码并返回布尔结果。

say.text: 给智能体添加持久化记忆，让它记住对话历史。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create AI agents in Python code. You can define functions that agents execute automatically, or spawn independent agents to handle tasks, with support for memory, tool use, and multi-agent coordination.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you write Python code to build AI agents, integrate MCP tools, or implement multi-agent orchestration.

say_en.text: Write an addition function using the @agentic decorator.
say_en.note: Claude generates an agentic function that computes the sum of two numbers.

say_en.text: Spawn an agent to judge if 'The Earth is flat' is true.
say_en.note: Claude generates code and returns a boolean result.

say_en.text: Add persistent memory to the agent so it remembers conversation history.
say_en.note: Claude uses persist=True to maintain state.
